description: Search memecub: Chinese 表情包 / 斗图 and English reaction memes and meme templates collected from the web (commercial_use=false), plus openly licensed emoji, art and photos (commercial_use=true). Search for the reaction you want in 1-3 words; Chinese queries find Chinese 表情包, English queries find English memes. Every result says whether it is cleared for commercial use and has a Markdown snippet that already includes any required credit line. Authenticated callers also get their private library.

commercial_only.description: Only images cleared for commercial use. Web-collected memes have commercial_use=false.

include_profanity.description: Also return memes whose captions contain swearing (common in 斗图). Off by default.

kind.description: meme = meme or 表情包 image, gif = animated meme, upload = the caller's own uploads

min_size.description: Skip images smaller than this many pixels on either side; 150 suits articles

no_credit.description: Only commercially usable images that need no attribution

query.description: Reaction or concept, e.g. 'facepalm', 'mind blown', '无语', '摸鱼'

name: search_memes
title: Search memes
